correctness.rationale: Exact breadth-first shortest-path counting includes one length-zero path per vertex and counts each unordered pair once. Independent C++17 exhausts all 2^21 seven-vertex labeled graphs: 1,866,256 connected, max49, 455 labeled maximizers split 35 12-edge plus 420 11-edge. Standard seven-vertex Graph Atlas has 1,044 isomorphism representatives; extending all by each of 128 eighth-vertex neighborhoods covers every 8-vertex graph. Independently recomputed 133,632 extensions, 119,980 connected, max74, nine maximizing extension records (four 14-edge, five 15-edge). Reviewed witness orbit argument of verify8.cpp and matching deletion counts. These are genuinely finite exhaustive bounds, not extrapolation; classification depends on correctness/completeness of the independently generated graph-atlas input.

Knor et al. 2026 supply global bounds and smaller-order statements, while Problem 14 and 15 leave unrestricted/bipartite extremizers broadly open. Exhaustive certificate yields new precise boundary at n=8, with residual risk of an older independent small-order census.
